conditions: indoor chamber tests of 5 treatments with 3 replicates each, 10 seeds of this species per treatment; 14 h light / 10 h dark; gap light 125, understory light 6 and dark below 0.13 umol m-2 s-1; the Methods give the gap temperature cycle as 20-30 C, but Table 4 labels the gap column 20/25 C, and the 93% is attributed to Figure 7C and Table 4 although Figure 8 is the temperature figure; the darkness result is one sentence covering T. maxima, Melastoma sanguineum and this species; seeds collected at Bawangling, Hainan 1-2 months before the test; the paper prints the name as Trema tomentosa
